title: Shared-tier README omits the required directory overview
detail: The code-folder README template makes a directory tree mandatory when the target has any immediate subdirectories (.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-readme/assets/readme-code-template.md:52). The shared-tier README has no contents/tree section (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/README.md:1 and :3-9), while shared/scripts is a direct child and contains the shipped modules and tests. Confirmed by comparing the template, README text, and direct file inventory.

title: Shared-tier README describes an obsolete empty state
detail: The shared-tier README says the hub currently ships no shared helpers (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/README.md:8-9), but the current direct inventory contains jev-transport.mjs and scorer-report.mjs and the scripts README describes both (.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/README.md:16-20, 28-30). Confirmed by matching the statement against the on-disk files and contents table.
